rows.prospective_caption_requirement: Identify member/junction revision, pressure versus gravity and buoyancy allocations, receiving reactions, equilibrium and declared supports.
rows.reject_caption_if: Supported fixture credited as free-floating equilibrium; self-weight hiding absent pressure transfer; reaction result detached from its load contract.

rows.prospective_caption_requirement: Caption member identity, span, section/frame, imperfection, demand basis, full target/path and native/equilibrium/mesh evidence separately.
rows.reject_caption_if: Incomplete path or nonconvergence called collapse; synthetic stress treated as material allowable; imposed bow treated as measured imperfection.

rows.prospective_caption_requirement: Name the ideal straight beam, eigenproblem, boundary conditions and independent mesh/model checks; preserve diagnostic scope.
rows.reject_caption_if: Eigenvalue treated as measured installed capacity, nonlinear stability or shell/film/printed-node qualification.

rows.prospective_caption_requirement: Distinguish displaced station from true imposed end couples; identify PP/CC ideal fixtures, applied load line and receiving torque convention.
rows.reject_caption_if: Station offset presented as true load-line eccentricity; ideal fixity presented as measured joint stiffness; missing couple response or comparison controls.

rows.prospective_caption_requirement: Identify standalone beam, combined axial/edge demand and prescribed dead-load scope; retain transfer and equilibrium requirements.
rows.reject_caption_if: Prescribed edge demand called equilibrated membrane transfer or whole-cell shell/film capacity.

rows.prospective_caption_requirement: Caption geometry/domain, solver/closure, normal completion, convergence, mesh and matching force/pressure reference states as separate evidence.
rows.reject_caption_if: Native exit or force agreement erases numerical FAIL; mismatched pressure state credited as experimental agreement; benchmark credited as hull qualification.

rows.prospective_caption_requirement: Label calculated component allocations separately from missing independent conditioned weighing and enclosed-volume observations.
rows.reject_caption_if: Calculated mass described as physically weighed; omitted hardware/seams/supports or a geometry illustration declared buoyancy closure.

rows.prospective_caption_requirement: Identify actual end/stock/pose and the complete hardware/tool sweep; distinguish primitive illustration, solid topology and local minimum section from complete installed evidence.
rows.reject_caption_if: Representative primitive or median wall called complete clearance, true minimum wall, printability, retention or installed strength.

rows.method: Shell, film and wall applicability gap
rows.prospective_caption_requirement: State the missing wall/membrane/contact/constitutive/load-transfer model and comparison evidence beside any proposed caption.
rows.reject_caption_if: Beam model or imposed edge load substituted for unsupported shell/film/wall representation.

rows.prospective_caption_requirement: Identify actual batch/orientation/conditioning, coupon or installed article, calibration, uncertainty, joint/bond/contact state and duration-specific evidence.
rows.reject_caption_if: Synthetic constitutive assumptions or numerical success credited as actual manufacturing, bearing, pull-out, creep or sealing qualification.

rows.prospective_caption_requirement: Retain prior-link, executed-control, superseded and unrun roles with exact immutable source references; inspect the linked scope before treating a predecessor as direct support.
rows.reject_caption_if: Unrun declaration credited as executed evidence, preserved invalid variant erased, prior acceptance enlarged beyond its source or a missing linked ledger treated as verified.

rows.method: Pressure, leakage and outgassing caption requirements
rows.prospective_caption_requirement: Identify the same conditioned sealed article, pressure and temperature history, duration, instrument calibration and protocol that separates outgassing from leakage.
rows.reject_caption_if: Pressure rise alone called leak rate without temperature/outgassing separation, assumed sealing credited as observation or a proposed degradation allowance treated as adopted.

missing_semantics: Null evidence/figure/caption/result fields are unavailable, not zero or completed evidence.
historical_policy: Keep numerical FAIL, incomplete single-mesh evidence, unrun declarations and manufacturing UNKNOWN distinct in the source record. Nonconvergence is not physical collapse. No historical case outcomes republished here.
private_source_policy: Private outcome values, identities, counts and curves excluded. This derivative does not assert that any proposed caption is supported.

requirement_definitions.prospective_method: Condition and weigh each identified tube, node, film, barrier, seam, adhesive, hardware and allocated support with calibrated uncertainty.
requirement_definitions.invalidates_applicability: Missing components, moisture state or a different bill/boundary; calculated volume-density products are not weighing.
requirement_definitions.criterion_status: UNKNOWN; use only an explicitly adopted applicable source criterion

requirement_definitions.prospective_method: Independently weigh the conditioned sealed article and reconcile component allocations and assembly deltas.
requirement_definitions.invalidates_applicability: Component totals credited as an independent assembled observation, double-counted neighbour structure or omitted hardware.
requirement_definitions.criterion_status: UNKNOWN; use only an explicitly adopted applicable source criterion

requirement_definitions.prospective_method: Record dimensional observations of the same sealed boundary and article revision; attach raw geometry and uncertainty.
requirement_definitions.invalidates_applicability: Pitch-cube, external envelope or another revision substituted for enclosed volume.
requirement_definitions.criterion_status: UNKNOWN; use only an explicitly adopted applicable source criterion

requirement_definitions.prospective_method: In a separately authorized protocol, record pressure, temperature, duration and conditioning with calibrated instruments.
requirement_definitions.invalidates_applicability: Pressure rise attributed to leakage without separating outgassing or temperature effects; a proposed degradation allowance treated as adopted.
requirement_definitions.criterion_status: UNKNOWN; use only an explicitly adopted applicable source criterion

requirement_definitions.prospective_method: Specify all stock ends, split parts, lugs, holes, fasteners, locks and neighbour allocations on one complete revision.
requirement_definitions.invalidates_applicability: Primitive end mass, friction-only retention or nominal fasteners extrapolated to complete installed hardware.
requirement_definitions.criterion_status: UNKNOWN; use only an explicitly adopted applicable source criterion

requirement_definitions.quantity: signed swept clearance and final engagement
requirement_definitions.prospective_method: Identify every affected end and fixed-node pose; record assembly sequence and sweep including tools, stock and tolerance envelopes.
requirement_definitions.invalidates_applicability: Only convenient representatives sampled, changed source pose/stock size or tool clearance omitted.
requirement_definitions.criterion_status: UNKNOWN; use only an explicitly adopted applicable source criterion

requirement_definitions.prospective_method: Specify local minimum-wall/section inspection and resolution on the complete toleranced solid.
requirement_definitions.invalidates_applicability: Median wall or a closed/non-self-intersecting mesh flag treated as printability or minimum wall.
requirement_definitions.criterion_status: UNKNOWN; use only an explicitly adopted applicable source criterion

requirement_definitions.quantity: secured assembly state after tool withdrawal
requirement_definitions.prospective_method: Describe load-bearing contact and positive locking parts; specify evidence of access, installation and final retention.
requirement_definitions.invalidates_applicability: Ideal contact, assumed friction or hidden fasteners supplying a result; primitive model treated as full node.
requirement_definitions.criterion_status: UNKNOWN; use only an explicitly adopted applicable source criterion

requirement_definitions.quantity: member identity, section, frame, load line and fixture
requirement_definitions.prospective_method: Crosswalk each proposed receiving reaction/displacement to applied demand and declared constitutive and fixture assumptions.
requirement_definitions.invalidates_applicability: Station-offset case mixed with true load-line eccentricity, gravity hiding pressure transfer or ideal restraint credited as measured fixity.
requirement_definitions.criterion_status: UNKNOWN; use only an explicitly adopted applicable source criterion

requirement_definitions.prospective_method: Keep native exit, complete target, equilibrium, independent mesh and model controls in separate fields.
requirement_definitions.invalidates_applicability: Incomplete path or solver nonconvergence declared a physical limit load; single mesh or insufficient reference points called converged.
requirement_definitions.criterion_status: UNKNOWN; use only an explicitly adopted applicable source criterion

requirement_definitions.quantity: tube-wall, film, contact and joint applicability
requirement_definitions.prospective_method: Name each required surface/constitutive/load-transfer representation and the evidence needed before importing a beam conclusion.
requirement_definitions.invalidates_applicability: Beam/eigen result treated as wall, membrane, printed-node or installed capacity; prescribed edge load treated as equilibrated skin.
requirement_definitions.criterion_status: UNKNOWN; use only an explicitly adopted applicable source criterion

requirement_definitions.prospective_method: Record stock batch or print/laminate orientation, conditioning and separately applicable tensile/compressive/shear observations and uncertainty.
requirement_definitions.invalidates_applicability: Fibre/catalogue/tensile proxy used as measured laminate, compressive or bearing allowable; unidentified conditioning/batch.
requirement_definitions.criterion_status: UNKNOWN; use only an explicitly adopted applicable source criterion

requirement_definitions.prospective_method: Record curvature, wall/section dimensions, batch and local frames with uncertainty on the intended member.
requirement_definitions.invalidates_applicability: Synthetic imperfection amplitudes or nominal stock geometry substituted for measured article.
requirement_definitions.criterion_status: UNKNOWN; use only an explicitly adopted applicable source criterion

requirement_definitions.quantity: translation, rotation and load centroid response
requirement_definitions.prospective_method: Prospective joint coupon record identifies contact/bondline, loading direction, calibration, force/displacement and moment/rotation.
requirement_definitions.invalidates_applicability: Ideal PP/CC bound or prescribed eccentricity substituted for installed stiffness/load centroid.
requirement_definitions.criterion_status: UNKNOWN; use only an explicitly adopted applicable source criterion

requirement_definitions.prospective_method: Separately authorized coupons would retain raw response, failure mode, bondline, geometry, batch, conditioning and uncertainty.
requirement_definitions.invalidates_applicability: Material-coupon stress or elastic diagnostic declared installed capacity; no applicable acceptance basis.
requirement_definitions.criterion_status: UNKNOWN; use only an explicitly adopted applicable source criterion

requirement_definitions.prospective_method: Prospective authorized protocol declares duration, temperature, humidity, preload and leak/outgassing separation before observation.
requirement_definitions.invalidates_applicability: Short-term response extrapolated to service duration or sealing results credited to untested structure.
requirement_definitions.criterion_status: UNKNOWN; use only an explicitly adopted applicable source criterion

requirement_definition_policy: Requirement IDs are locally defined prospective methods in this derivative, independently resolvable without an unlanded candidate; no private outcomes or scientific result imported.
